source.repositoryMetadata: No .git directory was supplied with the source tree.

wholeTreeFingerprint.algorithm: SHA-256 of the complete LF-terminated SHA256SUMS file. Each manifest entry includes the regular file's content digest and POSIX-relative path in deterministic bytewise order.

copy.method: Complete archive-mode copy of the supplied plain working tree, including hidden files, source, assets, tests, documentation, lockfiles, examples, scripts, and notices

sourceComparison.result: The supplied source and copied upstream trees have identical directory entries, relative paths, file bytes, and archive metadata.
sourceComparison.method: Identical deterministic source/copy SHA256SUMS, recursive diff with no differences, and archive-mode checksum rsync dry-run with no itemized changes

verification.manifestAlgorithm: Regular files beneath upstream are sorted by POSIX-relative path with LC_ALL=C. Each LF-terminated manifest line is lowercase SHA-256, two ASCII spaces, then the relative path.
